Proposition
[cutoff barrier is a strict supersolution] Source: cao-zhu 1. Claim 1\group Cao–Zhu Derivative Estimates Let \[ H= rac{(12+4\sqrt n)A^2}{\varphi ^2}+ rac1t+M. \] If $| abla \varphi |^2\le 2A^2$ and $\varphi | abla ^2\varphi |\le 2A^2$, then \[ \partial _tH>\Delta H-H^2+M^2. \]
Proof

\sketch Differentiate $\varphi ^{-2}$ and insert the two assumed cutoff bounds; the $\varphi ^{-4}$ and $t^{-2}$ terms in $H^2$ give the strict inequality.

□
